name: Low-Carb Sausage, Broccoli and Cheddar Egg Casserole
ingredients: 3 cup Broccoli (optional - cut into florets if using)
why: Egg-and-cheese-bound crustless bake (12 eggs, heavy cream, 2 cups cheddar hold sausage + broccoli) - dish identity is the custard bake, not the meat. Published 463 cal / 25.7g protein / 4.2g carbs per serving sits mid-band on both axes. All main ingredients map to the board (breakfast-sausage, broccoli, garlic, eggs, heavy-cream, cheddar->shredded-cheese, fresh-parsley, olive-oil). Scales cleanly to 14 as a weigh-and-divide bake; no seafood. Distinct from existing sausage-hash-brown-egg-casserole (that one is potato-based/carby; this is crustless low-carb).
